comment: Where each world's concept scheme lives: repository, file, pinned commit. scripts/fetch_worlds.py checks the pinned commit out under worlds/<world>; guard, renderer and the site read from there. 'branch' is the default branch, used for edit links. 'glossary' is the address of the world's glossary page per language; scripts/render.py builds the cross-world links in views/<world>.json from it ('anchor': 'heading' when the page anchors entries by their heading, not by local name).
